what: Parse ROADMAP.md's nodes: and unspecified: blocks and roadmap/nodes/<id>.json into a graph, and expose `switchboard roadmap lint <clone> --json`.
expectations: A dependency cycle, an unknown after id, a duplicate id or a node with no spec file is reported by id.
A build node missing verify, files_allowed, test_files or code_map_entries is reported.
Every features: id has at least one node, or is reported.
This repo's own nodes: block lints clean.
